Seminar Title:

Special Topic by Industry Expert - MN4555 / MN6999 -Emerging Opportunities and Challenges in Critical Mineral Exploration: The Role of Geosciences, Technology, and Industry-Academia Collaboration in Atma Nirbhar Bharat

Seminar Type:

Departmental Seminar

Department:

Mining Engineering

Speaker Name:

Dr. D. K. Sinha, Chief Executive Officer, Gujarat Mineral Research Industrial Consultancy Society

Speaker Type:

External Professional

Venue:

Mining Department Seminar Hall

Date and Time:

04 Nov 2026 03.30 PM

Contact:

Dr. Yugal Kishor Patanwar (9681678018)

Abstract:

This seminar is all about to cover the aspect of India’s critical mineral requirements and strategic imperatives for clean energy, advanced manufacturing, and national security, alongside national initiatives designed to bolster resource resilience. The session will detail modern approaches to mineral exploration and internationally recognized resource evaluation frameworks, particularly for deep-seated deposit targeting. Attendees will gain insight into emerging technologies transforming the sector—including AI-driven geological modeling, high-resolution airborne geophysics, hyperspectral imaging, and digital twin applications—supported by real-world case studies from successful critical mineral and uranium exploration projects. Moving into professional development, the lecture will address the evolving career opportunities and essential skill requirements for young mining engineers and geoscientists navigating an increasingly automated, data-centric industry. Finally, the speaker will emphasize the vital role of industry-academia collaboration in aligning university curricula with modern field technologies, driving joint R&D initiatives, and establishing mentorship pathways to prepare the next generation of professionals to lead India’s resource security mandate.
